pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Extend Boost

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Extradimensional Cover
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, extradimensional, focus, manipulate, wizard
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You've learned how to bring extradimensional spaces filled with debris into your current reality.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description: You've learned how to bring extradimensional spaces filled with debris into your current reality. You create this extradimensional cover in a square within range that is either empty or occupied by you or an ally. The extradimensional cover doesn't impede movement through it, but only you and your allies can end your movement in the space. If another creature attempts to end their movement in the cover, they are pushed to the nearest unoccupied space chosen at random. The space merges reality with your demiplane, creating swaths of semi-real debris which provide standard cover to any creature occupying the space.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Extradimensional Cover

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Fact Check
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You use your arcane knowledge to double-check the information learned.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
**Trigger** You or an ally within 30 feet attempts a check to Recall Knowledge using a skill in which you're trained.

You use your arcane knowledge to double-check the information learned. You briefly summon a 2-inch-tall illusory avatar of your subconscious onto your shoulder, which takes the form of how you view yourself, and helps out by sorting through your memories for you. Attempt a check using the same skill as the triggering check.

**Critical Success** Your avatar tells you if the information is correct and the correct answer if it's incorrect. You can ask the GM one follow-up question that the GM answers truthfully.

**Success** Your avatar tells you if the information is correct and the correct answer if it's incorrect.

**Failure** Your avatar tells you if the information is correct.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Fact Check

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Force Fang
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You briefly transform your attack into pure force energy to bypass your opponent's defenses.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You briefly transform your attack into pure force energy to bypass your opponent's defenses. You magically shift your weapon or unarmed attack into a spike of pure force that deals 1d4+1 force damage to a target within your melee reach. If you can use Spellstrike with a ranged weapon (with the starlit span hybrid study, for example), you can instead target a creature in the first range increment of your ranged weapon.

**Heightened (+2)** The damage increases by 1d4+1.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Force Fang

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Force Fling
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.requirements: You're wielding two melee weapons in different hands or a melee weapon in one hand and nothing in your other hand
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: A magical force echo of your weapon flies out to attack a foe.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
**Requirements** You're wielding two melee weapons in different hands or a melee weapon in one hand and nothing in your other hand.

A magical force echo of your weapon flies out to attack a foe. Make a melee Strike with a weapon you're holding, except that your target can be anywhere within 15 feet and any physical damage the weapon would deal is force damage instead. If this Strike targets a creature you haven't attacked yet this turn, its multiple attack penalty is –4 if it's your second attack this turn (–3 if you're using an agile weapon) or –8 if it's your third or further Strike (–6 with an agile weapon).

Spell Effect: Force Fling
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Force Fling

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Frenzied Revelry
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: rare, cleric, concentrate, emotion, focus, manipulate, mental
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.targets: you and allies in the area
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You recall memories of hedonistic rites to send yourself into an infectious frenzy, dancing and howling wildly to encourage your companions to join in.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You recall memories of hedonistic rites to send yourself into an infectious frenzy, dancing and howling wildly to encourage your companions to join in. You and your allies gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against mental effects while in the area. Whenever someone benefiting from this bonus critically succeeds at a saving throw against an enemy's mental effect, its revelry increases, granting it a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls for 1 round.

Spell Effect: Frenzied Revelry

**Heightened (4th)** The emanation's radius is 10 feet, and the status bonus to saves is +2.

**Heightened (7th)** The emanation's radius is 15 feet, and the status bonus to saves is +3.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Focus Spells: Frenzied Revelry

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Garden of Healing
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, animist, aura, emotion, focus, healing, mental
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: Spirits of comfort and respite swirl around you, trailing visions of growing grass and blooming blossoms.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
Spirits of comfort and respite swirl around you, trailing visions of growing grass and blooming blossoms. When you cast this spell and the first time you Sustain it on each subsequent round, you generate a pulse of renewing energy that heals each creature within the emanation for 1d4 Hit Points. The calm of this effect lingers; once this spell ends, any creature that has been affected by its healing gains a +1 circumstance bonus to saves against emotion effects for 10 minutes but does not receive any healing from additional castings of the spell while the bonus persists.

Spell Effect: Garden of Healing

**Heightened (+1)** The healing granted by the spell's pulse increases by 1d4 Hit Points.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: War of Immortals — Focus Spells: Garden of Healing

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Hollow Heart
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: rare, cleric, concentrate, emotion, fear, focus, manipulate, mental
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You stoke the target's ambition beyond reason, until it believes no one is capable of helping it, or that others aren't to be trusted.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You stoke the target's ambition beyond reason, until it believes no one is capable of helping it, or that others aren't to be trusted. The target attempts a Will saving throw.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target treats no other creature as an ally for 1 round.

**Failure** The target treats no other creature as an ally for 3 rounds.

**Critical Failure** As failure, and the target is Frightened 1 as it realizes it can't rely on anyone but itself.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Focus Spells: Hollow Heart

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Keen Smell
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, focus, manipulate, morph, ranger
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: Your nose becomes more sensitive to the scents of the wild, the better for you to track your quarry.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
Your nose becomes more sensitive to the scents of the wild, the better for you to track your quarry. For the spell's duration, you gain scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. Your hunted prey can't be undetected by you as long as it's within your scent range.

Spell Effect: Keen Smell

**Heightened (3rd)** Your scent range increases to 60 feet.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Howl of the Wild — Focus Spells: Keen Smell

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Life Tap
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: Using a thrall as a siphon, you attempt to drain the life essence of a creature and use it to restore the life of yourself or an ally.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
Using a thrall as a siphon, you attempt to drain the life essence of a creature and use it to restore the life of yourself or an ally. One creature within 30 feet of the targeted thrall must attempt a Fortitude saving throw. The targeted thrall is then destroyed.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is Drained 1 but recovers after 1 minute. You or an ally of your choice within 30 feet of the thrall regains Hit Points equal to double the amount the creature lost. A creature can be healed by this spell only once every 10 minutes.

**Failure** As success, but Drained 2.

**Critical Failure** As success, but Drained 3.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Life Tap

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Muscle Barrier
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You transform a thrall into layers of thick muscle that wrap around you or an ally, providing both protection and a boost to strength.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You transform a thrall into layers of thick muscle that wrap around you or an ally, providing both protection and a boost to strength. The thrall is split into pieces and flung toward a willing creature within 15 feet of it, destroying the thrall and granting that creature 10 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute. The creature gains a +1 status bonus to Athletics checks until the spell ends. The spell ends when all the temporary Hit Points are gone.

Spell Effect: Muscle Barrier

**Heightened (+1)** The temporary Hit Points increase by 10.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Muscle Barrier

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Necrotic Bomb
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, focus, manipulate, necromancer, void
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You overload one of your thralls with void energy, causing it to explode.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You overload one of your thralls with void energy, causing it to explode. Each creature within a 10-foot emanation of the thrall takes 1d12 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. This destroys the thrall.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d12.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Necrotic Bomb

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Nymph's Grace
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, animist, aura, emotion, focus, incapacitation, mental, visual
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: Your apparition manifests as a mask of unearthly beauty that bewilders your enemies.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description: Your apparition manifests as a mask of unearthly beauty that bewilders your enemies. The first time an enemy enters the aura each round, or if they start their turn within the aura, they must succeed at a Will saving throw or become confused for 1 round. While confused by this effect, the creature's confused actions never include harming you.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: War of Immortals — Focus Spells: Nymph's Grace

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: River Carving Mountains
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: Your apparition solidifies around you into roaring water and spraying mist.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
Your apparition solidifies around you into roaring water and spraying mist. For the duration of this spell, you have lesser cover against ranged attacks and gain a +10-foot status bonus to each Speed you have. When you first cast this spell and each time you Sustain it, you can Stride up to your speed while your apparition fills each square you pass through with the lingering energy of a coursing river. These squares become difficult terrain until the start of your next turn. You can use *river carving mountains* while Burrowing, Climbing, Flying, or Swimming instead of Striding if you have the corresponding movement type.

Spell Effect: River Carving Mountains
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: War of Immortals — Focus Spells: River Carving Mountains

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Shielding Strike
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: As you attack a foe, warding magic transforms your momentum into action and lifts your shield.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description: As you attack a foe, warding magic transforms your momentum into action and lifts your shield. You can either Raise a Shield if you're wielding one or cast Shield if you have the spell. Then, make a melee Strike.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Shielding Strike

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Shooting Star
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.requirements: You’re wielding a ranged weapon or a thrown weapon.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You let loose a projectile that flies true and leaves the blazing trail of a meteor behind it.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
**Requirements** You're wielding a ranged weapon or a thrown weapon.

You let loose a projectile that flies true and leaves the blazing trail of a meteor behind it. Make a ranged Strike, ignoring the target's Concealment and reducing the target's cover by one degree for only this Strike (greater to standard, standard to lesser, and lesser to none). If the Strike hits, the meteor trail hangs in the air. This gives the benefits of concealment negation and cover reduction to any attacks made against the creature (by anyone) until the start of your next turn.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Shooting Star

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Slime Spit
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, focus, manipulate, poison, ranger
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You spit toxic goo that coats your target's face and eyes, dealing 2d6 poison damage.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You spit toxic goo that coats your target's face and eyes, dealing 2d6 poison damage. It must attempt a Reflex save.

**Critical Success** The target takes no damage.

**Success** The target takes half damage and is dazzled for 1 round, though it can Interact to wipe its eyes and remove the condition.

**Failure** The target takes full damage and is dazzled until the end of your next turn.

**Critical Failure** The target takes double damage, is blinded for 1 round, and is dazzled until it uses an Interact action to wipe its eyes.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Howl of the Wild — Focus Spells: Slime Spit

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Song of the Soul
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, focus, healing, manipulate, necromancer
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You shape a thrall into an instrument that plays a silent song that can be heard by only one soul.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You shape a thrall into an instrument that plays a silent song that can be heard by only one soul. Choose one living or undead creature of your choice within 15 feet of the target thrall. That creature regains 1d8 Hit Points immediately and gains fast healing 1 for as long as it's within 15 feet of the target thrall. This spell has the vitality trait if you heal a living creature or the void trait if you choose an undead creature.

Spell Effect: Song of the Soul

**Heightened (+1)** The healing increases by 1d8 and the fast healing increases by 1.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Song of the Soul

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Spinning Staff
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You spin your staff with an impossibly quick twirling flourish, attacking two foes and transforming the momentum into magical energy to charge for your next Spellstrike.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
**Requirements** You're wielding a staff.

You spin your staff with an impossibly quick twirling flourish, attacking two foes and transforming the momentum into magical energy to charge for your next Spellstrike. Make a melee Strike with your staff against one foe and then a second melee Strike with your staff against a different foe. Your multiple attack penalty applies to both of these attacks as normal.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Spinning Staff

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Store Time
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You store time for later use.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description: You store time for later use. When you Cast this Spell and the first time you Sustain it each round, you gain a bonus reaction that you can use for any animist or apparition reaction you have. As normal, this reaction is lost if you do not use it before you regain your actions at the start of your next turn.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: War of Immortals — Focus Spells: Store Time

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: String of Fate
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You bond yourself to a cherished friend, vowing to share their fate for good or for ill.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description: You bond yourself to a cherished friend, vowing to share their fate for good or for ill. Whenever an effect would require both you and the target to attempt a saving throw, if one of you succeeds at your saving throw and the other critically fails, you can choose to both fail instead. You and the ally must agree to fail; otherwise, use your normal save results instead.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Focus Spells: String of Fate

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Temporal Distortion
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You share some of your own temporal distortions with a foe, altering their mind and body unpredictably as they're thrown backward or forward in time.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You share some of your own temporal distortions with a foe, altering their mind and body unpredictably as they're thrown backward or forward in time. Roll 1d4. On a 1, the foe becomes clumsy; on a 2, it becomes enfeebled; on a 3, it becomes stupefied; and on a 4, you choose which condition applies.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is either Clumsy 1, Enfeebled 1, or Stupefied 1 for 1 round, depending on the result of the d4.

**Failure** The target is either clumsy 1, enfeebled 1, or stupefied 1 for 4 rounds, depending on the result of the d4.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the time warp is stronger, increasing the condition's effects but making it run its course faster. The condition's value is 3, and the condition lasts for 2 rounds.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Focus Spells: Temporal Distortion

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Thunderous Strike
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.requirements: You're wielding a melee weapon in two hands.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You swing your massive weapon, creating a wave of sonic vibrations that topples creatures.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
**Requirements** You're wielding a melee weapon in two hands.

You swing your massive weapon, creating a wave of sonic vibrations that topples creatures. Make a melee Strike with your two-handed weapon. Each creature in a 15-foot cone from you must attempt a basic Fortitude save against your spell DC or take 2 sonic damage. On a critical failure, the creature is knocked prone. The target of your Strike must be within the cone or the effect fails.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Thunderous Strike

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Traveling Workshop
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.duration: sustained up to 1 minute, or 8 hours
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: Your apparition guides you through complex procedures while using your magic to provide you with whatever tools you need.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
Your apparition guides you through complex procedures while using your magic to provide you with whatever tools you need. For the duration of this spell, you are trained in Crafting and Thievery. When you Cast the Spell and as long as you Sustain it, your apparition provides you with an array of simple tools, granting you use of an alchemist's toolkit, a repair kit, and a thieves' toolkit; these tools are made of ephemeral magic and disappear if they leave your possession.

Spell Effect: Traveling Workshop

You can cast this spell as an exploration or downtime activity with a casting time of 10 minutes; when you do, its duration increases to 8 hours (enough to complete 1 day of work), and you also gain an alchemist's lab and functioning forge. You are always treated as having spent a day of work setting up when using this spell to help you Craft an item and have whatever materials you need to Repair an item in your possession. You can't use a traveling workshop to Earn Income and any item you Craft using it disappears moments after it leaves your possession, making it unwise to Craft anything other than consumable items you intend to use yourself. A crafter in the vault is extremely proud of work you do together when using the spell in this way and demands to see the results of your work together. When you cast traveling workshop as an exploration or downtime activity, you must continue to choose crafter in the vault as one of your attuned apparitions during your next daily preparations until such time as you've used any Crafted items in combat.

**Heightened (3rd)** Your proficiency in Crafting and Thievery is expert.

**Heightened (5th)** Your proficiency in Crafting and Thievery is master.

**Heightened (9th)** Your proficiency in Crafting and Thievery is legendary.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: War of Immortals — Focus Spells: Traveling Workshop

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Trickster's Mirrors
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, animist, focus, illusion, mental, visual
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You are surrounded by up to 3 mirrors that reflect twisted and distorted images of you, making it hard to tell where you actually are within your space and potentially causing those who attack you…
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You are surrounded by up to 3 mirrors that reflect twisted and distorted images of you, making it hard to tell where you actually are within your space and potentially causing those who attack you to hit one of the mirrors instead. You start with 1 mirror and gain an additional mirror each time you Sustain this spell, up to a maximum of 3 mirrors. Any attack that would hit you has a random chance of hitting one of your mirrors instead of you. With one mirror, the chances are 1 in 2 (1–3 on 1d6). With two mirrors, there is a 1 in 3 chance of hitting you (1–2 on 1d6). With three mirrors, there is a 1 in 4 chance of hitting you (1 on 1d4).

Once an image is hit, it is destroyed. If an attack roll fails to hit your AC but doesn't critically fail, it destroys a mirror. If the attacker was within 5 feet, they must succeed at a basic Will save or take 1d4 mental damage as they believe themselves cut by a shower of glass shards from the breaking mirror. A damaging effect that affects all targets within your space (such as Caustic Blast) destroys all of the mirrors.

**Heightened (+1)** The mental damage dealt by a broken mirror increases by 1d4.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: War of Immortals — Focus Spells: Trickster's Mirrors

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Unfetter Eidolon
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You loosen the link between yourself and your eidolon, allowing them to travel farther from you for a short period of time and aiding them against being immobilized.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You loosen the link between yourself and your eidolon, allowing them to travel farther from you for a short period of time and aiding them against being immobilized. While the spell is active, your eidolon can travel an unlimited distance away from you and gains a +1 status bonus to saving throws and DCs against any effect that would make them grappled, immobilized, or restrained, plus the Reposition and Swallow Whole actions.

When the spell ends, if your eidolon is more than 100 feet away from you, they unmanifest.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Unfetter Eidolon

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Victory Cry
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: Your true might comes from your bonds with your allies, and you glory in their achievements.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
**Trigger** An ally within range critically succeeds at a melee Strike.

Your true might comes from your bonds with your allies, and you glory in their achievements. The weapon used to make the Strike deals an additional 1d6 sonic damage (not doubled due to the critical hit), and the ally can immediately attempt to Shove the creature struck, even if the ally's hands are full. Your ally can use its item bonus to the triggering attack roll on the Athletics check, if any, and it gains a +1 status bonus to the Athletics check if the triggering Strike was with a weapon that has the trip trait or an unarmed attack that has the trip trait.

**Heightened (+2)** The sonic damage increases by 1d6.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Focus Spells: Victory Cry

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Vindicator's Mark
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You launch a magical dart at your hunted prey, which marks them with a nimbus only you can detect.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You launch a magical dart at your hunted prey, which marks them with a nimbus only you can detect. Make a spell attack against the target. On a hit, you deal 2d4 spirit damage and the target is marked by a glowing nimbus of energy that only you can see. For the duration of your spell, the marked target takes an additional +2 damage from all your weapon or unarmed attacks. invisible targets marked by your *vindicator's mark* are concealed to you, rather than undetected.

You can Dismiss the spell on your turn if your last action dealt damage to the target with a weapon or unarmed attack, instantly dealing an additional level-based spirit damage to it.

Spell Effect: Vindicator's Mark

**Heightened (+2)** The initial damage increases by 2d4, the additional damage you deal increases by 1, and the damage dealt when the spell is Dismissed increases by 1d6.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: War of Immortals — Focus Spells: Vindicator's Mark

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Bony Barrage
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You shatter the skeleton of a thrall, creating a volley of teeth, vertebrae, and phalanges.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You shatter the skeleton of a thrall, creating a volley of teeth, vertebrae, and phalanges. Destroy the target thrall, and each creature in a 30-foot cone originating from the thrall's former space takes 2d10 piercing damage with a basic Reflex save. You can destroy a second thrall in the cone's area to cover you and any allies in the area in bone armor. If you do, you and affected allies take no damage from this spell and gain a +1 status bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

Spell Effect: Bony Barrage

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d10.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Bony Barrage

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Canopy Crawler
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, focus, manipulate, morph, ranger
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: The target grows a prehensile tail, or gains prehensile qualities in their existing tail, to help them climb with ease.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
The target grows a prehensile tail, or gains prehensile qualities in their existing tail, to help them climb with ease. For the duration of the spell, they gain a climb Speed equal to their highest Speed. The target can Climb with a hand occupied (or two hands occupied if they have the Combat Climber feat).

Spell Effect: Canopy Crawler

**Heightened (5th)** The spell's duration increases to 1 hour, and you can target both yourself and your animal companion with a single casting.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Howl of the Wild — Focus Spells: Canopy Crawler

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Imitate Fauna
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, focus, illusion, manipulate, ranger
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You use your knowledge of nature to pass the target off as a common animal of the same size, representing a species chosen when the spell is cast.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You use your knowledge of nature to pass the target off as a common animal of the same size, representing a species chosen when the spell is cast. This covers the target's visual appearance, scent, and voice. The target can communicate with other members of the species as though they shared a language but can't speak other languages while the spell persists.

Casting *imitate fauna* counts as setting up a disguise for the purpose of the Impersonate action. It allows the target to ignore any circumstance penalties they might take for being disguised as dissimilar creatures, and it gives the target a +4 status bonus to Deception checks to prevent other animals from seeing through their disguise. You can Dismiss this spell.

Spell Effect: Imitate Fauna

**Heightened (5th)** You can target up to six willing animals.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Howl of the Wild — Focus Spells: Imitate Fauna

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Lifelink Surge
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, focus, healing, manipulate, summoner, vitality
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You make a quick gesture, tracing the link between yourself and your eidolon and drawing on your connection to slowly strengthen your shared life force.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You make a quick gesture, tracing the link between yourself and your eidolon and drawing on your connection to slowly strengthen your shared life force. Your eidolon gains Fast Healing 4 for 4 rounds.

Spell Effect: Lifelink Surge

**Heightened (+1)** The fast healing increases by 2.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Lifelink Surge

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Spirit of the Beast
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You bring out the spirit of another animal that lives within your companion.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You bring out the spirit of another animal that lives within your companion. Its body morphs slightly to take on an aspect of the animal you choose to have it emulate—for example, it might grow a pair of horns if the spirit is a bull or a tail if the spirit is a monkey. When you Cast this Spell, select from one of the following aspects.

Spell Effect: Spirit of the Beast

- **Aspect of Might:** Your companion gains a +1 status bonus to Athletics checks, Intimidation checks to Demoralize, and Fortitude saves.
- **Aspect of Swiftness:** Your companion gains a +1 status bonus to Acrobatics checks, Stealth checks to Hide or Sneak, and Reflex saves.
- **Aspect of Insight:** Your companion gains a +1 status bonus to Perception checks to Seek, Survival checks to Sense Direction or Track, and Will saves.

**Heightened (5th)** The status bonuses increase to +2.

**Heightened (8th)** The status bonuses increase to +3.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Howl of the Wild — Focus Spells: Spirit of the Beast

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Bind Heroic Spirit
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, focus, manipulate, necromancer, thrall
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You turn one of your thralls into a conduit to bind the spirit of a hero into your body.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You turn one of your thralls into a conduit to bind the spirit of a hero into your body. Destroy the target thrall and gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and saving throws. Additionally, whenever you critically hit a creature with a Strike, you can create a thrall in a space adjacent to the target of the Strike, as your heroic attack inspires other spirits to join you on the battlefield.

Spell Effect: Bind Heroic Spirit

**Heightened (6th)** The status bonus increases to +2.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Bind Heroic Spirit

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Blood in the Water
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, focus, hex, manipulate, spirit, witch
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.requirements: The target is taking persistent bleed damage or your last action dealt slashing damage to the target.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: Predators are drawn to the scent of blood, and blood can disperse shockingly far in the water.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
**Requirements** The target is taking persistent bleed damage or your last action dealt slashing damage to the target.

Predators are drawn to the scent of blood, and blood can disperse shockingly far in the water. You summon the spirits of aquatic predators to appear as a spectral swarm around the target. When you Cast or Sustain this Spell, the target takes 2d6 spirit damage (basic Reflex save). If the target takes any damage from the spell, it treats all water as difficult terrain for 1 round as the predators try to drag them down. The spectral predators don't take up space, grant flanking, or have any other attributes a creature would. If you deal slashing damage to the target while the spell is active, you automatically Sustain this Spell. If you cast blood in the water while a previous casting of this hex is still in effect, the previous effect ends.

**Heightened (+2)** The damage dealt increases by 2d6.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Howl of the Wild — Focus Spells: Blood in the Water

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Bloody Tendrils
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, focus, manipulate, necromancer, thrall
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You conjure forth stationary tentacles formed from pure, partially hardened blood.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You conjure forth stationary tentacles formed from pure, partially hardened blood. You create up to 3 Medium thralls shaped like bloody tendrils in range. These tendrils are immune to physical damage and can't move. The tendril's Strike has a reach of 10 feet. Whenever an enemy ends it turn within the reach of one or more tendrils, the tendril lashes out at them, dealing 1d12 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex save.

**Heightened (+3)** The number of thralls this spell can create increases by 1, and the damage increases by 1d12.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Bloody Tendrils

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Conjurer's Countermeasure
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.duration: until the end of your next turn
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You quickly create a barrier that protects you against the magic of spellcraft.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You quickly create a barrier that protects you against the magic of spellcraft. You gain resistance 5 against damage from spells.

The resistance from this spell is cumulative with that of Arcane Cascade. If you're in Arcane Cascade stance when the duration of *conjurer's countermeasure* expires, the spell's duration extends until Arcane Cascade ends.

**Heightened (+3)** The resistance increases by 5.

Spell Effect: Conjurer's Countermeasure
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Conjurer's Countermeasure

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Eidolon's Wrath
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, eidolon, focus, manipulate, summoner
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: Your eidolon releases a powerful energy attack that deals 5d6 damage of the type you chose when you took the Eidolon's Wrath feat, with a basic Reflex save.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
Your eidolon releases a powerful energy attack that deals 5d6 damage of the type you chose when you took the Eidolon's Wrath feat, with a basic Reflex save.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Eidolon's Wrath

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Mycological Malady
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, disease, focus, hex, manipulate, witch
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You infect your target with fungal spores to hasten the cycle of decay.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You infect your target with fungal spores to hasten the cycle of decay. The target must attempt a Fortitude saving throw. Undead that aren't incorporeal, such as skeletons and zombies, don't have their normal immunity to this disease, as the spores can still colonize their remaining flesh and bone. This might also apply to other non-living creatures made of organic material at the GM's discretion.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target sprouts mushrooms and is Enfeebled 2 for 1 round.

**Failure** The target is afflicted with voidcap spores at stage 1.

**Critical Failure** The target is afflicted with voidcap spores at stage 2.

**Voidcap Spores (disease)** This disease ends when the spell ends;

**Stage 1** enfeebled 2 (1 round)

**Stage 2** enfeebled 2 and Slowed 1 (1 round)

**Stage 3** enfeebled 2, slowed 1, and Stupefied 2 (1 round)
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Howl of the Wild — Focus Spells: Mycological Malady

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Return the Favor
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You're unable to leave any debts unpaid.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
**Trigger** An ally uses a reaction to grant you a beneficial effect during a combat encounter.

You're unable to leave any debts unpaid. When an ally supports you in a fight, you offer assistance in turn for the favor. The triggering ally gains 12 temporary Hit Points for 1 minute.

**Heightened (+1)** The temporary Hit Points increase by 4.

Spell Effect: Return the Favor
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Focus Spells: Return the Favor

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Sheltering Wings
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.requirements: An ally moves through a square within 15 feet of you or uses an action that has the move trait.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: Like migratory birds, you know everyone flies farther together.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
**Trigger** An ally moves through a square within 15 feet of you or uses an action that has the move trait.

Like migratory birds, you know everyone flies farther together. You cause immense wings to sprout from your familiar. Your familiar Flies up to 30 feet, though it must move toward the triggering ally. If your familiar ends this movement adjacent to the triggering ally, it lands on their back; until the beginning of your next turn, the familiar automatically is carried by the ally, and its wings provide them cover. When the spell ends, the familiar hops off your ally into an adjacent square.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Howl of the Wild — Focus Spells: Sheltering Wings

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Threatening Mimicry
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, emotion, fear, focus, illusion, manipulate, mental, ranger
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You appear larger and stronger to nearby creatures, appearing to possess threatening features like antlers, claws, or poison to their senses.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You appear larger and stronger to nearby creatures, appearing to possess threatening features like antlers, claws, or poison to their senses. Each non-allied creature in the area must attempt a Will save.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is Frightened 1. This condition doesn't decrease at the end of its turn if it damaged you during that turn.

**Failure** As success, but Frightened 2.

**Critical Failure** As success, but Frightened 3.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Howl of the Wild — Focus Spells: Threatening Mimicry

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Time Skip
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You manipulate time around your ally, pushing them forward a few moments in time.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You manipulate time around your ally, pushing them forward a few moments in time. The target is quickened on its next turn and can use the action only to Step, Stride, or Strike.

**Heightened (6th)** You can affect up to four willing creatures other than yourself within range.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Focus Spells: Time Skip

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Warning Stripes
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, focus, morph, poison, ranger
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: Your skin becomes painted with vivid stripes or bright aposematic swirls, warning other creatures of its toxic qualities.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
Your skin becomes painted with vivid stripes or bright aposematic swirls, warning other creatures of its toxic qualities. Any creature that touches you or hits you with an unarmed melee attack takes 2d8 poison damage. If you have an animal companion, you can cast this spell on them instead, with a range of 30 feet.

**Heightened (+2)** The poison damage increases by 1d8.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Howl of the Wild — Focus Spells: Warning Stripes

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Wings of the Valkyrie
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: Powerful feathered wings—usually vibrant white or jet black—emerge from your back, granting you a fly Speed equal to your Speed.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
Powerful feathered wings—usually vibrant white or jet black—emerge from your back, granting you a fly Speed equal to your Speed. You can use these wings to attempt to Shove a creature; you don't need a free hand to do so, and you can roll using your spell attack modifier instead of your Athletics skill for the check. When this spell's duration ends, if you're still flying, you float to the ground, as Gentle Landing.

Spell Effect: Wings of the Valkyrie

**Heightened (5th)** The duration increases to 1 minute.

Spell Effect: Wings of the Valkyrie (Heightened)
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Battlecry! — Focus Spells: Wings of the Valkyrie

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Zombie Horde
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You create a horde of nearly endless, but temporary, zombies.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You create a horde of nearly endless, but temporary, zombies. You destroy the target thrall, and the zombie horde appears in a 10-foot burst, which must include a square the destroyed thrall occupied. All squares on the ground in the zombie horde are difficult terrain. Whenever a creature begins its turn in the horde, it takes 3d4 bludgeoning damage with a basic Fortitude save.

Once per round on subsequent turns, you can Sustain the spell to move the horde up to 15 feet. At the start of each of your turns, all of your thralls in the horde are destroyed, and the area's burst increases by 5 feet for each thrall destroyed (to a maximum of a 30-foot burst). You can Dismiss this spell.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d4.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Zombie Horde

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Conglomerate of Limbs
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, focus, manipulate, necromancer, thrall
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You conjure forth a humongous thrall consisting solely of undead severed limbs.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You conjure forth a humongous thrall consisting solely of undead severed limbs. You create a Huge thrall within range. This thrall has 40 Hit Points and a Speed of 25 feet.

When you use Thrall Charge to order this thrall to make a Strike, it makes two melee unarmed Strikes instead of one, each against a different creature within 10 feet. Your multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after the thrall makes both Strikes. A creature hit by one of these Strikes must also succeed at a Fortitude saving throw or become grabbed by the thrall for 1 round (or restrained on a critical failure) or until it Escapes. Attempts to Escape don't automatically succeed, and the Escape DC is your spell DC.

**Heightened (+1)** The thrall's Hit Points increase by 10.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Conglomerate of Limbs

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Euphoric Renewal
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You view death not as an ending but a beginning, and you delight in dancing on its edge.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You view death not as an ending but a beginning, and you delight in dancing on its edge. Each time you gain the dying condition and then regain consciousness while under the effect of euphoric renewal, you gain three benefits.

- You're quickened on your next turn. You can use the extra action only to Stand.
- You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saves for 1 minute.
- You gain 8 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 minute.

Spell Effect: Euphoric Renewal

**Heightened (+1)** The number of temporary HP increases by 2.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Focus Spells: Euphoric Renewal

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Hot Air
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: Your enemies are full of hot air, so you make their lungs burn when they try to talk.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
Your enemies are full of hot air, so you make their lungs burn when they try to talk. The target takes 4d6 fire damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a failed save, the target also burns whenever they speak, causing them to take (your level) fire damage whenever they use an action with the auditory trait or Cast a Spell, unless their spell is subtle.

**Heightened (+1)** The initial fire damage increases by 1d6, and the fire damage the target takes whenever they take an action with the auditory trait or Cast a Spell increases by 1.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Hot Air

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Inevitable Destination
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You twist the paths of the target, ensuring that each one leads to you.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You twist the paths of the target, ensuring that each one leads to you. The target attempts a Will saving throw.

**Critical Success** The spell has no effect.

**Success** Your pull hampers the target's footsteps. It takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds until the end of its next turn.

**Failure** The target can't move any farther from you than it was when you Cast the Spell, though it can move in such a way that it maintains an equal distance. If you move farther away from the target than the initial distance, the spell ends. The targeted foe can attempt to Escape against your spell DC. If it succeeds, the spell ends.

**Critical Failure** As failure, plus the target is pulled 10 feet closer to you and falls prone, tripping in its haste to move toward you.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Focus Spells: Inevitable Destination

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Isolation
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: rare, cleric, concentrate, focus, illusion, manipulate
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You summon a tangible manifestation of loneliness to cloak the target from view as surely as if it were wreathed in darkness.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You summon a tangible manifestation of loneliness to cloak the target from view as surely as if it were wreathed in darkness. The target attempts a Will saving throw.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target becomes invisible, but only to its allies. Any creature not allied with the target can see it normally. Effects such as See the Unseen enable an ally to see the target. The target's allies still know the target is present and can still see all the effects of the target's actions.

**Failure** As success, except the target also becomes inaudible to its allies and imperceptible to them through any other senses.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Focus Spells: Isolation

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Path of Least Resistance
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You trace several possible routes, quickly resetting the timeline until you find the safest one.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description: You trace several possible routes, quickly resetting the timeline until you find the safest one. Choose three spaces you could reach with two Stride actions. Each must be at least 20 feet from the other two. You Stride twice to one of the spaces, determined randomly by the GM from among the paths you chose. If some of the paths contain a hidden danger, such as a trap that you would trigger by walking into the trap's affected area, the GM doesn't consider this path when randomly determining which one you take, but if all options have a hidden danger, the GM randomly chooses between all three paths. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Focus Spells: Path of Least Resistance

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Purifying Veil
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: rare, cleric, concentrate, focus, holy, manipulate, spirit, water
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: Drawing on the purifying powers of water, you call forth a veil of fine water droplets suffused with holy energy.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
Drawing on the purifying powers of water, you call forth a veil of fine water droplets suffused with holy energy. The veil surrounds the target. Everything on each side of the veil is concealed from creatures on the opposite side, but the water doesn't impede attacks or movement across the veil. If the target moves through the veil, it takes 4d6 spirit damage with a basic Will save. If the target leaves the veil, the spell ends.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 1d6.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Focus Spells: Purifying Veil

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Quantic Dampening
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, aura, concentrate, focus, manipulate, wizard
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You demonstrate exceptional control over elemental forces, allowing you to mitigate the effects of energy damage.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You demonstrate exceptional control over elemental forces, allowing you to mitigate the effects of energy damage. As a reaction, whenever you or an ally in the area would attempt a basic Reflex save to resist an effect that deals acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, or sonic damage, they use the outcome one degree of success better than the result of their saving throw.

**Heightened (8th)** The area increases to a 30-foot emanation.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Quantic Dampening

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Runic Impression
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.targets: you or one weapon you're wielding
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: Your unarmed attacks or your weapon gain the benefits of a weapon rune you choose when you cast this spell: Corrosive, Flaming, Frost, Ghost Touch, Returning, Shock, or Thundering.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
Your unarmed attacks or your weapon gain the benefits of a weapon rune you choose when you cast this spell: Corrosive, Flaming, Frost, Ghost Touch, Returning, Shock, or Thundering. If you cast *runic impression* on a weapon, this spell ends if you cease holding the weapon, with the exception of throwing a *returning* weapon. If this spell would give a weapon more property runes than its normal maximum, one of the existing property runes (your choice) is suppressed until the spell ends. For unarmed attacks, if this spell would give you more property runes than you could have from Handwraps of Mighty Blows, one of the existing property runes is similarly suppressed.

**Heightened (8th)** Add keen to the list of runes you can choose as well as the greater versions of Corrosive, Flaming, Frost, Shock, and Thundering.

Spell Effect: Runic Impression
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Runic Impression

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Sanguine Transference
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You diffuse your spirit into your blood before escaping your body and transferring your blood and soul into a thrall.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You diffuse your spirit into your blood before escaping your body and transferring your blood and soul into a thrall. You use the target thrall to reform your body in its space, and you leave a thrall where your body once was.

Your reformed body is the same as it was before the transfer. All spells and effects applied to you remain active. Tendrils of blood grab all your items as you travel and equip them to your new body as they were before the transfer. The movement of your blood doesn't trigger any reactions.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Sanguine Transference

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Shaken Confidence
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: rare, cleric, concentrate, emotion, focus, mental, misfortune
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.targets: An enemy that critically failed an attack roll, Perception check, or skill check
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You mock the target for all its failings, twisting its self-confidence into doubt.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
**Trigger** An enemy within 30 feet of you critically fails an attack roll, Perception check, or skill check.

You mock the target for all its failings, twisting its self-confidence into doubt. The enemy attempts a Will saving throw.

**Success** The target is unaffected.

**Failure** The target is briefly shaken and unsure of its abilities. It must roll twice and take the worse result on the next roll of the same type as the critical failure that triggered the spell (such as the target's next Acrobatics check if the spell's trigger was a critical failure on an Acrobatics check). If the target doesn't attempt any qualifying checks, the spell ends at the end of the target's next turn.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Focus Spells: Shaken Confidence

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Shielding Formation
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, focus, force, manipulate, wizard
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You conjure magical shields of force to protect your allies around you.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You conjure magical shields of force to protect your allies around you. You and each ally who ends their turn within the emanation gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC until they leave the emanation or the spell ends, whichever comes first. If an ally takes physical damage or damage from a spell or magical effect while being granted this bonus, they can choose to end the bonus for themselves as a free action to gain resistance 10 to all damage against the triggering damage. If they do, they become temporarily immune to the effects of *shielding formation* for 10 minutes. You can do the same by spending your reaction; if you do, you can't cast *shielding formation* again for 10 minutes, though you can continue Sustaining the benefits for others.

Spell Effect: Shielding Formation
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Battlecry! — Focus Spells: Shielding Formation

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Songbird's Call
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, aura, bard, composition, concentrate, focus
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: Your voice calls a storm of songbirds that whirl around you and peck at your enemies.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
Your voice calls a storm of songbirds that whirl around you and peck at your enemies. All creatures within the area of whirling birds become concealed, and all creatures outside the area become concealed to creatures within it. A creature other than you that enters or ends its turn in the area takes 1d6 piercing damage as the birds peck at it.

**Heightened (+2)** The damage increases by 1d6.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Howl of the Wild — Focus Spells: Songbird's Call

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Unbounded Sphere
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You magically desynchronize the current plane of existence, trapping creatures in an area that loops back on itself in the manner of an unbounded plane.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You magically desynchronize the current plane of existence, trapping creatures in an area that loops back on itself in the manner of an unbounded plane. Whenever a creature attempts to enter or leave the area, they must attempt a Will saving throw.

**Critical Success** The creature moves into or out of the area as intended.

**Success** The creature moves into or out of the area successfully but appears it a random unoccupied space adjacent to the edge of the area.

**Failure** The creature fails to enter or exit the area, instead appearing at a random, unoccupied space adjacent to the edge of the area, and their movement immediately ends.

**Critical Failure** As failure, except the creature can't attempt to enter or leave again this turn.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Unbounded Sphere

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Unsettling Perspective
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, emotion, focus, mental, wizard
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You reach into a creature's mind and give them a glimpse of their place in the universe, learning how they perceive their position within society while damaging their mind with the truth of their…
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You reach into a creature's mind and give them a glimpse of their place in the universe, learning how they perceive their position within society while damaging their mind with the truth of their insignificance relative to all of existence. The target takes 2d10 mental damage and must attempt a Will save.

**Critical Success** The creature takes no damage.

**Success** The creature takes half damage, and you gain a general sense of their position and importance within their society.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage, and you learn the creature's social status within their society as well as one of their connections to a leader in their society, if any exist.

**Critical Failure** As failure, except the creature takes double damage and is Stunned 1. You can attempt a skill check to Recall Knowledge about the creature the next time you Refocus to remember additional information that you may have learned but didn't have time to process in the moment.

**Heightened (+2)** The damage increases by 1d10.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Unsettling Perspective

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Waking Dream
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You cloud the target's mind with vivid, dreamlike imagery, so they have difficulty distinguishing real threats from imagined ones.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You cloud the target's mind with vivid, dreamlike imagery, so they have difficulty distinguishing real threats from imagined ones.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is distracted by the visions and treats all other creatures as concealed for 1 round, and you can't Sustain the Spell to increase the duration.

**Failure** The target is confused. In addition to the creatures present, the target might also attack wildly at thin air, attempting to fend off the dreams. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns to end the confusion. Even if the confused effect ends early, the target treats all other creatures as concealed for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target gets no save to end the effect early.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Focus Spells: Waking Dream

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Weaponize Secret
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: rare, cleric, concentrate, focus, manipulate, mental
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You understand that holding a secret is in itself a kind of power.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You understand that holding a secret is in itself a kind of power. Each target must attempt a Will save.

**Success** The target is unaffected.

**Failure** A rune symbolizing a secret the target is keeping (at the GM's discretion) appears floating in front of you. If that creature attempts a Strike or spell attack against you while you hold their secret, you can discharge the rune as a reaction to deal 7d6 mental damage to the creature.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target becomes convinced you know their secret and takes 1d6 persistent mental damage from worry. If the rune with the secret is discharged while the creature is still taking the persistent mental damage, the persistent mental damage immediately ends.

**Heightened (+1)** The mental damage increases by 2d6, and the persistent mental damage on a critical failure increases by 1.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Focus Spells: Weaponize Secret

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Wind Whispers
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: rare, cleric, concentrate, focus, linguistic, manipulate, mental
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You call forth numerous breezes in which you weave gossip, whispering subtly into the ears of those around.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You call forth numerous breezes in which you weave gossip, whispering subtly into the ears of those around. Choose a rumor or information you wish to spread, which may or may not be true, about a single subject. Those within range of the spell overhear the rumor at some point over the next hour, though they'll be unable to pin it down to a source. Attempt a check with a modifier equal to your spell DC - 10 against a hard DC for your level. The GM might modify the DC depending on how plausible the rumor is. Repeated castings to spread the same rumor or information have no effect unless circumstances have substantially changed, as determined by the GM.

**Critical Success** Your rumor spreads far and wide, and it's at the tip of people's tongues. For 1 week, anyone who succeeds at a check to Gather Information on the specific subject learns your rumor in preference to other rumors about the subject. Skill checks to convince people that the rumor is true get a +2 circumstance bonus.

**Success** Enough people take note of the rumor that it begins to spread, though those who heard the rumor aren't necessarily convinced. For 1 week, anyone who succeeds at a check to Gather Information on the specific subject adds your rumor to the list of rumors they could learn about the subject, and skill checks to convince people that the rumor is true get a +1 circumstance bonus.

**Failure** Most in the area dismiss the rumor as wild gossip and pay it little mind, granting no effect.

**Critical Failure** The winds' gossip is misinterpreted and spreads information contradictory to the rumor you were attempting to spread. A contradictory rumor spreads, and skill checks to convince others that your original rumor is true take a -2 circumstance penalty.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Focus Spells: Wind Whispers

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Wordsmith
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.targets: 1 document written by a single author and comprised of written text in a single language
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.duration: until the next time you Refocus
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You're a devotee of knowledge with an unmatched command of the language used to spread that knowledge, and you can reshape the written word into a form more understandable to your audience.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description: You're a devotee of knowledge with an unmatched command of the language used to spread that knowledge, and you can reshape the written word into a form more understandable to your audience. The language of the target's written text shifts to a language you know. This shift doesn't change the text's contents beyond minor translation differences, nor does it grant the reader any understanding of the original language.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Focus Spells: Wordsmith

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Blossoming Gore
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, focus, manipulate, necromancer, thrall
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: By spilling the blood of a thrall, you grow a large field of bloody roses that feeds on the life force of those around it and uses it to create thralls that do your bidding.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
By spilling the blood of a thrall, you grow a large field of bloody roses that feeds on the life force of those around it and uses it to create thralls that do your bidding. This field appears in a 20-foot burst centered on a corner in the target thrall's space, and that thrall is destroyed. A creature that enters or starts its turn in the area takes 10 persistent bleed damage from the rose's thorns. You can Dismiss this spell.

If a bleeding creature ends its turn in the area, it must attempt a Fortitude saving throw.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is Drained 1.

**Failure** The creature is drained 1, and a single thrall is created in an unoccupied space adjacent to the field.

**Critical Failure** The creature becomes Drained 2, and 2 thralls are created in unoccupied spaces adjacent to the field.

**Heightened (+1)** The persistent bleed damage increases by 2.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Blossoming Gore

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Gluttonous Growth
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, focus, manipulate, plant, ranger
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: Plants in the area grow rapidly, taking on carnivorous characteristics as they seek to consume prey.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
Plants in the area grow rapidly, taking on carnivorous characteristics as they seek to consume prey. All affected squares are difficult terrain, both on the ground and for flying creatures. Each creature that begins its turn in the area must attempt a Reflex save unless it's already grabbed or restrained.

When you Sustain this spell, each creature grabbed or restrained by the plants takes 4d6 piercing damage.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature is grabbed until the beginning of its next turn or it Escapes.

**Failure** The creature is grabbed until the spell ends or it Escapes.

**Critical Failure** The creature is restrained until the spell ends or it Escapes.

**Heightened (+1)** The damage dealt by the plants when you Sustain the spell increases by 2d6.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Howl of the Wild — Focus Spells: Gluttonous Growth

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Let Not the Fallen Rest
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, focus, healing, manipulate, sorcerer
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You exhort your fallen comrades to return to the battle.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You exhort your fallen comrades to return to the battle. Each allied creature within the emanation whose dying value is 2 or less regains 4d10 Hit Points and can Stand as a free action, which doesn't provoke reactions.

**Heightened (+1)** The amount of healing increases by 1d10.

Conscious characters are not considered to have the dying 0 condition and are unaffected.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Battlecry! — Focus Spells: Let Not the Fallen Rest

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Over the Coals
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, focus, hex, manipulate, mental, witch
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You accuse the target of breaking its word to you and invoke the wrath of your patron to claim what's due, demanding the target pay you in currency, fulfill an order, or stand down.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You accuse the target of breaking its word to you and invoke the wrath of your patron to claim what's due, demanding the target pay you in currency, fulfill an order, or stand down. The demand can't be obviously self-destructive, or the spell fails. If the target resists, you take your payment from its life force. The target must attempt a Will save. Regardless of the result of its save, the target is temporarily immune for 1 day.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected and is immune to your pact broker cantrips for 1 day.

**Success** If the target doesn't comply with your request by the end of its next turn, it takes 3d8 persistent void damage. If it later complies, the spell automatically ends.

**Failure** As success, but if the target doesn't comply, it is Drained 1 and takes 6d8 persistent void damage.

**Critical Failure** As success, but if the target doesn't comply, it is Drained 2 and Doomed 1, and takes 6d8 persistent void damage. Even if the target completes your commands later, the spell doesn't end until all the conditions end.

**Heightened (9th)** You can target up to two creatures.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Focus Spells: Over the Coals

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Pack Breaker
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, focus, manipulate, mental, ranger
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You can deceive creatures by changing their perception of their allies' behavior.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You can deceive creatures by changing their perception of their allies' behavior. Each affected creature suspects their allies have changed allegiance, depending on the outcome of their Will save. Regardless of the effects of the saving throw, the creature is then temporarily immune to pack breaker for 1 hour.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature becomes unfriendly to all creatures to which it wasn't already hostile, even those that were previously allies. It treats no one as an ally for 1 minute. Each of its former allies within its reach must attempt a save against pack breaker.

**Failure** As success, but the creature is also confused for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** As success, but the creature is confused for 1 minute.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Howl of the Wild — Focus Spells: Pack Breaker

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Pulverizing Wake
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, attack, concentrate, focus, manipulate, ranger, sonic
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: Imitating raptorial creatures, you attack with such speed it drives a sonic shockwave.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
Imitating raptorial creatures, you attack with such speed it drives a sonic shockwave. Make a melee Strike against a creature in your reach; if you hit, you deal an additional 3d8 sonic damage. Regardless of the result of your Strike, that creature becomes the point of origin of a 15-foot cone, aimed directly away from you. All creatures in that cone take 6d8 sonic damage (basic Fortitude save).

**Heightened (+1)** The damage of the cone increases by 1d8.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Howl of the Wild — Focus Spells: Pulverizing Wake

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Vindicator's Judgment
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You pronounce a terrible judgment upon your quarry that causes all of your attacks and divine spells to strike with deadly efficacy.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You pronounce a terrible judgment upon your quarry that causes all of your attacks and divine spells to strike with deadly efficacy. The target takes extra damage from your attacks, depending on the result of its Fortitude save. The spell ends immediately if the target is no longer your hunted prey.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target has weakness 5 to the next Strike you make against it or damaging divine spell you cast that includes it as a target before the end of your next turn.

**Failure** The target has weakness 5 to all Strikes you make against it or damaging divine spells you cast that includes it as a target for the duration of the spell.

**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target is off-guard against the first Strike or divine spell attack you make against it each round for the duration of the spell.

**Heightened (7th)** The weakness is 10.

**Heightened (9th)** The weakness is 15.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: War of Immortals — Focus Spells: Vindicator's Judgment

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Bridge of Graves
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You summon a bridge formed from grave dirt and tombstones that allow thralls to move with great speed.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You summon a bridge formed from grave dirt and tombstones that allow thralls to move with great speed. The 10-foot-wide span must start at the ground on a point within range, and it extends as a horizontal plane, either in a straight line or at any angle up to 45 degrees upward or downward, for up to 120 feet. This bridge has AC 10, Hardness 30, and 40 Hit Points. A thrall on or adjacent to the bridge can move to any location on the bridge when you command it to Stride. You can Dismiss the spell.

**Heightened (+1)** The length of the bridge increases by 20 feet, its Hit Points increase by 20, and you can increase the width of the span by up to an additional 5 feet.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Bridge of Graves

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Manifold Lives
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, emotion, focus, manipulate, mental, oracle
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You cast a creature's mind back through time, forcing them to take other paths and make other choices, experiencing countless alternate lives in an instant.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You cast a creature's mind back through time, forcing them to take other paths and make other choices, experiencing countless alternate lives in an instant. The creature becomes overwhelmed with regret over paths untraveled, lives unlived, and times unrealized. The creature takes 6d6 mental damage and must attempt a Will save. After the effect is resolved, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 day.

**Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.

**Success** The creature takes half damage and is Stupefied 2 for 1 round.

**Failure** The creature takes full damage and is stupefied 2 for 1 minute. While affected, the creature must attempt another save at the start of its turn; on a failure, it's Slowed 1 for that turn as it sobs uncontrollably.

**Critical Failure** The creature takes double damage and for 1 minute, it's Stupefied 4 and slowed 1 as it sobs uncontrollably.

**Heightened (+1)** The mental damage increases by 1d6.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Focus Spells: Manifold Lives

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Spellsurge
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: Magic surges to life around you, feeding on the raw power you radiate.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
Magic surges to life around you, feeding on the raw power you radiate. Choose one of the following abilities to affect creatures in your aura. You can choose a different effect, ending the previous one, by Sustaining the spell. You can Dismiss the aura.

- **Interference** The excess magic surrounding you creates a mental static. All saving throws against mental effects gain a +2 circumstance bonus.
- **Mana Well** You become a source of pure magic that allows spells to be cast more freely. Allied creatures that would normally be required to attempt a flat check to Cast a Spell (such as from the stupefied condition) automatically succeed.
- **Overpower Resistance** Surging magic penetrates most defenses. Any time a spell affects a creature within the aura, that spell ignores an amount of the creature's resistance equal to your level. This applies to all damage the spell deals, including persistent damage and damage caused by an ongoing effect of the spell. This doesn't cause the spell to ignore immunities.
- **Ward** Stray magical energy diffuses damaging spells. Any time a spell affects a creature within the aura, the damage dealt by the spell is reduced by an amount equal to your level. This applies to all damage the spell deals, including persistent damage and damage caused by an ongoing effect of the spell.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: War of Immortals — Focus Spells: Spellsurge

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Hasted Assault
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You call upon your magic to speed up your attacks.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description: You call upon your magic to speed up your attacks. You gain the quickened condition and can use the extra action each round for only Stride and Strike actions. As normal, you don't gain an action on the turn you cast this spell, but you do when you regain actions at the start of your next turn.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Hasted Assault

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Recurring Nightmare
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, focus, manipulate, necromancer, thrall
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You conjure forth a ghostly thrall that isn't easily slain.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You conjure forth a ghostly thrall that isn't easily slain. You create a thrall within range, and you can create it in a space occupied by a creature. Unlike other thralls, the nightmare can share its space with other creatures, and other creatures can move through its space with ease. If this thrall is summoned into or ends its movement in a creature's space, the creature must succeed at a Will saving throw or become Frightened 1 (or Frightened 2 on a critical failure); this is an emotion, fear, and mental effect.

The thrall has a fly Speed of 60 feet and remains airborne at the end of your turn even if it didn't Fly that turn. Any ability you use that would make the thrall Stride allows it to Fly instead.

The thrall's Strikes deal void damage and must target a creature in the thrall's space. When you use Thrall Charge to order this thrall to make a Strike, that Strike deals an additional 2d6 damage.

If the thrall has been destroyed, you can Sustain this spell to resummon the thrall. You can do this only once per round.

**Heightened (8th)** The additional damage increases to 3d6.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Recurring Nightmare

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Skeletal Lancers
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, focus, manipulate, necromancer, thrall
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You conjure a force of skeletons wielding bony spears.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You conjure a force of skeletons wielding bony spears. You create up to 5 thralls in different spaces within range. When an enemy makes a Strike while within 10 feet of a skeletal lancer, the lancer deals 5 piercing damage to it. The enemy takes this damage only once per Strike, even if it's in the reach of multiple skeletal lancers.

The skeletal lancers have a Speed of 30 feet. Their Strikes have a reach of 10 feet and deal piercing damage.

When you command a skeletal lancer to Stride, you can have any number of your skeletal lancers Stride instead of just one. When you use Thrall Charge to order a skeletal lancer to make a Strike, that Strike deals an additional 2d6 damage.

**Heightened (8th)** The additional damage increases to 3d6.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Skeletal Lancers

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Flesh Tsunami
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You melt one of your thralls into a massive wave of sticky flesh.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description: You melt one of your thralls into a massive wave of sticky flesh. Destroy the target thrall to create an area of greater difficult terrain in a 60-foot cone originating from the thrall's former space. You can destroy a second thrall in the cone to make its limbs grasp your foes. If you do, each enemy in the area must succeed at a Fortitude saving throw or be immobilized for 1 round or until it Escapes; the Escape DC is your spell DC.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.cite: Impossible Magic — Focus Spells: Flesh Tsunami

pf2e-orc.spells.focus.name: Temporary Possession
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.traits: uncommon, concentrate, focus, incapacitation, manipulate, necromancer, possession
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.summary: You destroy the target thrall, using its destruction as a catalyst to temporarily possess an enemy.
pf2e-orc.spells.focus.description:
You destroy the target thrall, using its destruction as a catalyst to temporarily possess an enemy. One living or undead target creature within 15 feet of the destroyed thrall must attempt a Will saving throw.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is controlled by you until the end of your turn, and you can have it take up to one action of your choice: Drop Prone, Interact, Release what it's holding, or Strike.
